title: HolyCode Cloud - a cloud AI workstation with 60+ tools already installed
excerpt: A cloud Linux workstation with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, OpenCode and Pi plus Postgres, Playwright, Jupyter, pandas, pandoc and ffmpeg already installed. Root on your own machine, a disk that keeps your work.
content_html:
Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, OpenCode and Pi on one Linux box, with root and a disk that keeps your work.

A real session, replayed line for line  ·  the phone version →

Get started → From $19/mo. Cancel yourself anytime.

[ ~ ]

A real Linux box

Root on your own VM. Your home and workspace live on a disk that keeps them.

[ x6 ]

Six agent CLIs, preinstalled

Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode, Cursor and Pi on your PATH from first boot. Sign in and go.

[ :// ]

Reachable from any device

It's a browser tab. Start a run at your desk, check it from your phone on the train.

[ 1s ]

Persistent + instant resume

Suspends when idle, wakes in ~1 second with every file and process where you left it. After days idle it may cold-start instead: closer to a minute, files untouched.

[ >>> ]

Parallel agents, unlimited projects

Run as many sessions as your machine takes, overnight, while your laptop sleeps.

[ key ]

Bring your own key

Your Claude, OpenAI, or Gemini key stays on your box. The AI bill stays between you and your provider.

The loadout

Your agent stops asking to install things

An agent on an empty box spends its first 20 minutes running apt and npm. This one boots with the toolchain already there.

Agents

claude, codex, gemini, opencode, cursor, pi

Languages

node 24, python 3.11, gcc, make, build-essential

Package managers

npm, pnpm, yarn, uv, uvx, pip

JS / TS toolchain

typescript, tsx, vite, esbuild, eslint, prettier, nodemon, pm2, dotenv-cli

Databases

psql 17, redis-cli, sqlite3, prisma, drizzle-kit

Notebooks & data

jupyterlab, ipython, pandas, numpy, polars, matplotlib, seaborn

Embeddings & vectors

torch (CPU), sentence-transformers, tiktoken, sqlite-vec, chromadb

Browser & web

playwright + chromium, lighthouse, fastapi, uvicorn, requests, httpx, beautifulsoup4, http-server, json-server

Documents & media

pandoc, tesseract OCR, ffmpeg, imagemagick, pdftotext, pypdf, python-docx, openpyxl, yt-dlp, pillow

MCP servers

sdk, filesystem, memory, sequential-thinking

Shell

git, gh, tmux, vim, nano, ripgrep, fd, bat, jq, tree, htop, rsync, curl, wget, strace, lsof, dig, ssh, zip

Cloud

wrangler, plus root, so anything else is one apt away

Why not just use Claude Code on the web?

Often you should. It's free with Pro, Max and Team, and sessions survive a closed browser. A few agent tasks a week on a GitHub repo? That's the right tool.

We're not selling you an agent. We're selling you the machine it lives on.

Claude Code on the web

This box

The machine

Cloud sessions stop after a period of inactivity and the session's VM is reclaimed. You reopen to a fresh VM with your conversation history restored.

The same machine every time. What you install stays installed. Root, and a disk that's yours.

Agents

Claude.

Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode, Cursor and Pi. Six preinstalled, all on your PATH.

Pushing code

Repository cloning and pull request creation require GitHub. Other hosts can be sent up as a bundle, but that session can't push results back to the remote.

Your box, your remotes. GitLab, Bitbucket, a bare repo on a server you own.

Network

Network access is limited by default.

Open network.
